title: PingFederate → resource AS
lede: PingFederate is the IdP: it issues a short-lived, single-use ID-JAG from your session. resource-as is the MCP server's authorization server: it trusts PingFederate because this server's registry read lists PF_URL, redeems the ID-JAG and mints its own token. Only that token travels on to mcp-sample and the protected page.

nodes.label: Browser
sub: the playground page · session cookie only
Clicks each step's button
Sees decoded claims and redacted requests, never a raw token

nodes.label: Playground server · the OAuth client
sub: server/ · /api/id-jag-playground
Holds every token server-side: refresh token, ID-JAG, access token
Runs a pre-flight check before each button

nodes.label: PingFederate · issues the ID-JAG
sub: PF_URL · pf.example.invalid
Sign-in at its own login page (code + PKCE, offline_access)
Token exchange policy + SP connection with ID-JAG on
Signs typ oauth-id-jag+jwt · keys at /pf/JWKS (x5t)

nodes.label: resource-as · resource AS
sub: RESOURCE_AS_ISSUER · POST /token
Trusts an issuer only if its registry read (or TRUSTED_IDPS_FILE) lists it
Checks typ, signature, aud = its issuer, client_id, jti single-use
Mints its own at+jwt, aud = the MCP resource

nodes.label: mcp-sample · MCP server
sub: MCP_URL · POST /mcp
Verifies the token against resource-as /jwks: typ, iss, aud, exp
tools/list shows only what the scope allows

nodes.label: Protected resource
sub: GET /protected/profile on mcp-sample
Same bearer validation as the MCP tools
Says which check failed when it refuses

nodes.label: Trusted IdPs registry
sub: server · /api/id-jag-playground/trusted-idps/registry
Lists PF_URL once pf-as is configured, plus admin-approved outside IdPs
Read with Bearer ID_JAG_REGISTRY_TOKEN; no secrets in an entry

edges.label: sign-in dialog → /issuer/pi-flow (pi.flow at PingFederate, code + PKCE, prompt=login)
code → /issuer/callback · server keeps the refresh token
RFC 8693 token exchange · requested_token_type=id-jag · subject=refresh token · audience=RESOURCE_AS_ISSUER
RFC 7523 jwt-bearer · client_id RESOURCE_AS_CLIENT_ID · scope ⊆ ID-JAG
broken assertions: replay · tampered signature · other client · extra scope

steps.title: Sign in at PingFederate
steps.what: A fresh sign-in at PingFederate's own login page. The server swaps the code for tokens and keeps the refresh token: the ID-JAG is minted from it.
steps.why: Custody: the browser never holds a token. The server keeps each one in its session and returns decoded claims and redacted requests only.

steps.title: Get an ID-JAG from PingFederate
steps.what: RFC 8693 token exchange at PingFederate with requested_token_type=…:id-jag. subject_token is the refresh token, audience is resource-as's issuer, resource is the MCP server. PingFederate returns a JWT typed oauth-id-jag+jwt that lives about 5 minutes; the page checks it against the draft.

steps.title: Redeem at resource-as
steps.what: RFC 7523 JWT bearer grant at resource-as. It finds PingFederate on the registry it reads from this server, fetches its keys, checks typ, signature, iss, a single aud equal to its issuer, expiry, that client_id is the client redeeming now, and that the jti is unused. It grants at most the ID-JAG's scope and mints its own access token.
steps.why: resource-as trusts PingFederate because the server's registry read (Bearer ID_JAG_REGISTRY_TOKEN) lists PF_URL once pf-as is configured. No token set: "ID-JAG issuer is not trusted".

steps.title: Call mcp-sample
steps.what: tools/list and tools/call go straight to mcp-sample with resource-as's token. mcp-sample verifies it against resource-as's JWKS (typ at+jwt, iss, aud, exp) and lists only what the scope allows. Its /protected/profile takes the same token and must refuse no token and the raw ID-JAG.
steps.why: The ID-JAG stops at resource-as. The MCP call and the protected page carry resource-as's own token; the raw ID-JAG must be refused there.

steps.title: Negative tests
steps.what: Each test mints a fresh ID-JAG, breaks one thing (replay, signature, client, scope) and expects an OAuth error with no token.
steps.why: Each test mints a fresh ID-JAG (② again), breaks one thing and expects an OAuth error with no token. Replay is refused because resource-as keeps jti single-use.
